text: 据韩联社报道，韩国今年的超额税收收入可能超过50万亿韩元（约合370亿美元），这反映出半导体行业周期强于预期等因素。据韩联社计算，这可能会使未来应对基金（一种将超额税收收入用于战略投资和财政储备的政府工具）的规模超过200万亿韩元。报道称，经济财政部预计将在本月晚些时候发布的2026年修订版国家税收收入预测报告中公布这一数字。这笔意外之财将使政府有更多空间增加支出，而无需相应增加借贷。根据2027年的预算提案，半导体行业带来的这笔意外之财大部分将用于资助人工智能、芯片和青年发展，同时限制债券发行并建立财政缓冲。
text_en: According to Yonhap, South Korea's excess tax revenue this year may exceed 50 trillion won (about $37 billion), reflecting factors such as a stronger-than-expected semiconductor industry cycle. According to Yonhap calculations, this could push the size of the Future Response Fund, a government tool that uses excess tax revenue for strategic investment and fiscal reserves, above 200 trillion won. The report said the Ministry of Economy and Finance is expected to announce the figure later this month in its revised 2026 national tax revenue forecast report. This windfall will give the government more room to increase spending without a corresponding increase in borrowing. Under the 2027 budget proposal, most of the windfall from the semiconductor industry will be used to fund AI, chips and youth development, while limiting bond issuance and building fiscal buffers.
